source_title: 'We need to win both': Gautam Gambhir asks team India to win 'every match' of series - The Times of India
source_excerpt: India spinner Varun Chakaravarthy said head coach Gautam Gambhir has asked the team to aim for a win in every match, even after sealing the five-match T20I series against New Zealand. With India having won the first three games, the spinner said the team was treating the remaining two matches as a separate series and wanted to win both.India entered the fourth T20I at Eden Park in Auckland after winning all three previous matches, with their batters leading the way. So that's the goal. And the next two matches we'll be taking it as a two-match series. So we need to win both the matches,â he said.India's batting had been particularly impressive in the third T20I, when they chased down a target of 199 with 40 balls to spare. Abhishek Sharma led the chase with a 38-ball 113. Chakaravarthy said it would be difficult for the batters to better that performance, but hoped they could produce something similar.âI don't think you can top that, but I hope they can repeat that today. And yeah, they are used to playing in such pitches and such small venues. Yeah, so that played into our advantage for sure,â he said.Chakaravarthy, who is yet to play a match in the series, also spoke about the competition for places in the Indian team. He said players needed to keep working on their game and performing consistently, given the amount of talent available in Indian cricket.âPlaying in India, the best thing that you want to happen for yourself is being in the contention.
